title: Southern District
description: Agricultural land stretches from the hamlet's edge toward the distant Weald. At its heart, the Mill Grounds stand in uneasy balance between salvation and corruption, where townspeople's courage drew new ward lines closer to the comet's impact site. Beyond the wards' protection, the old Apple Yard marks where cultivation gives way to fungal wilderness.
summary: Agricultural land stretching toward the Weald, balancing between the Mill Grounds' salvation and the Apple Yard's fungal wilderness.

title: Granary
description: A collapsed agricultural storehouse of rotted siding and sagging rafters. The exterior loading dock has caved into the mud under the weight of overturned wagons, while flocks of ravens nest in the roof's gaping holes, picking at heaps of moldered grain in the dark below.
restored: A massive timber-and-iron storehouse elevated on heavy stone footings to deter pests and damp. Broad wooden ramps easily accommodate laden harvest wagons, while ventilated upper silos and hoppers keep sacks of grain, meal, and emergency rations dry and secure.
summary: The hamlet's bulk agricultural storehouse, equipped with heavy timber loading docks and ventilated silos for storing grain.

title: Sanguine Vintners
description: A collapsed winery whose ruined vats still bear the sickly-sweet smell of fermented harvests past. Broken glass and splintered oak barrels litter the loading dock, while the pressing room's rusted machinery sits frozen in decay. In the cellar, shattered bottles tell tales of desperate looters who found only vinegar and regret.
restored: An unsettling yet vital facility risen from the old winery's bones. Dark timbers and fresh stonework frame a building that resembles a proper vintner's operation, though its true purpose is betrayed by the corpses of the Courtyard's bloodsuckers visible through leaded windows. Inside, modern distillation apparatus and cooling systems ensure a steady supply of processed blood for the hamlet's cursed residents, while the cellar holds rows of carefully labeled vials rather than wine bottles.
summary: A collapsed winery reeking of fermentation and decay, now serving darker needs with its ruined vats and shattered bottles.

title: Root Cellar
description: A stone chamber accessed by wooden stairs, its door frame bearing the marks of the same axe that ended the desperate farmhand who barricaded himself inside when the invasion came. Now the shelves hold community stores: root vegetables, salted meat, preserves. The earthen floor stays cool, and the air smells of onions and earth.
summary: A stone storage chamber with a dark history from the invasion, now holding the community's preserved food stores.

title: Mill Grounds
description: A stretch of farmland rescued from deeper corruption when the townspeople moved the Ancestor's ward stones inward, dragging the carved slabs through frozen wheat on creaking carts. Though crystalline growths still pierce the soil and the Miller's towering form stalks these grounds with hostile intent, his presence can be avoided by careful travelers. The new ward line holds just as strong as the original, preventing further corruption from spreading outward from the comet's impact site.
summary: Rescued farmland guarded by shifted ward stones, where crystalline growths and the Miller's shadow mark the edge of safety.

title: Mill
description: A stark silhouette of stone and timber whose upper works hang suspended in mid-air in defiance of natural law. Crystalline growths crawl up the shattered masonry like frozen ivy, while the great millstone hangs motionless, caught between earthly mechanics and cosmic distortions. Through gaps in the walls, a pale cyan light pulses in time with otherworldly tremors.
restored: A massive timber-and-masonry windmill standing whole above the farmstead. Heavy iron-banded gears turn the great wheel steadily in the coastal wind, driving realigned grindstones to process wheat from reclaimed fields. Though shielded safely behind the ward stones, a faint luminescence still glimmers along the deepest foundation blocks.
summary: The agricultural windmill on the southern farmstead, housing a massive wheel and grindstones for flour production.

title: Tainted Well
description: A shattered masonry well where wild, runaway crystal growths have burst through the stonework, leaving the canopy crushed under fallen timbers. Glowing cyan brine spills across the cracked base and pools into the mud, poisoning the soil and rendering the flooded shaft completely unusable.
restored: A braced masonry well dominated by a colossal, glowing cyan crystal that juts straight through the center of its shingled roof. While the waters below are permanently infused with the comet's luminescence, the reinforced stone base and winch allow workers to safely draw the mineral-charged brine for specialized settlement use.
summary: A farmstead stone well pierced by a towering, luminescent comet crystal, utilized for drawing crystal-infused water.

title: Miasmal Orchard
description: A blighted thicket of blackened, twisted trees choked with jagged, uncontrolled crystal formations. Corrupted mists drift across the untamed soil, where the fractured wood bleeds a pale glow into the barren ground, far too dangerous and volatile for any worker to approach.
restored: A gnarled, blackened tree enclosed within a sturdy circular wooden fence, preserved as a contained cosmic anomaly. Massive clusters of cyan crystals burst from its boughs and roots, wreathed in a faint luminescent mist that workers harvest for crystalline growth and esoteric extracts.
summary: A fenced agricultural enclosure on the farmstead surrounding an ancient tree fused with glowing cosmic crystals.

title: Apple Yard
description: A small fenced-in piece of land on the Farmstead's southern edge, where the tended fields surrender to the Weald's advance. Twisted apple trees surround a weathered house and listing barn, their branches heavy with bloated fruit that pulses with parasitic life. A woman's mournful wail sometimes echoes across the grounds, begging for release from her fungal-ridden form.
summary: A fenced enclosure where tended fields surrender to fungal wilderness, haunted by twisted trees and a woman's mournful wail.

title: Apple Yard House
description: A sagging two-story home whose rotting walls sprout shelf fungi like hideous decorations. The front door hangs open perpetually, as if still reeling from the last time it was slammed in drunken rage. Through broken windows, the interior's fungal infestation glows with a sickly phosphorescence.
summary: A sagging home consumed by rot and shelf fungi, where the interior glows with the sickly phosphorescence of infestation.

title: Apple Yard Master Bedroom
description: A chamber where violence once reigned, now claimed by creeping rot. The bed's splintered headboard bears deep gouges, while dark stains mar the floorboards beneath years of fungal growth. A shattered mirror still clings to one wall, its fragments reflecting nothing but spreading decay.
summary: A chamber of past violence now claimed by creeping rot, featuring a gouged headboard and a mirror reflecting only decay.

title: Apple Yard Mother's Room
description: A narrow space beneath the eaves where fearful whimpers once echoed. Dried flowers fill cracked vases, their stems black with rot, while a small devotional icon lies face-down in the corner. The wallpaper peels away in long strips, revealing flourishing patches of luminescent growth.
summary: A narrow space beneath the eaves where rotted flowers and peeling wallpaper reveal flourishing patches of luminescent growth.

title: Apple Yard Daughter's Chamber
description: A small room that once held dreams of escape. A tarnished Conscript's pendant hangs beside a cracked mirror, while love letters moldering in a hidden compartment speak of promises never kept. Fungal blooms now trace the path of old tears down the walls, pulsing brighter whenever their former occupant's wails draw near.
summary: A small room holding moldering love letters and a tarnished pendant, where fungal blooms trace the path of old tears.

title: Apple Yard Kitchen
description: Broken bottles litter the floor around a heavy table scored by pitchfork tines. The hearth stands cold, though something pulses within the chimney's darkness. Shelves still hold preserving jars, their contents now hosting writhing forms that press against the clouded glass.
summary: A ruined workspace littered with broken bottles and preserving jars whose contents writhe against the clouded glass.

title: Apple Yard Barn
description: A listing structure where cattle once sheltered, now a monument to fungal conquest. The hayloft sags beneath masses of twisted growth, while old leather tack sprouts pale mushrooms from every stitch. Something that might once have been a pitchfork stands propped in one corner, its handle fused with the thing that grew around its wielder's grip.
summary: A listing structure surrendered to fungal conquest, containing sagging haylofts and tools fused by twisted growth.

title: Mass Grave
description: A suspiciously regular mound beyond the orchard's edge, where three bodies were said to be buried after the miasma took them. The Conscript's sword sticks out of the earth at an odd angle, alongside gifts left by others who pretended to mourn them.
summary: A suspiciously regular mound marked by a conscript's sword, burying the bodies taken by the miasma.

title: The Cut
description: A channel blasted through the farmstead's southern slope, graded wide enough for a single rail line that was never laid. Sleepers are stacked in bundles along the spoil heaps, beside barrows, spike hammers and a powder store left standing open. The surveyors' tents are still pitched at the far end, canvas stiff with ash. Crystal has come up through the rubble in patches, and the former crew roam around the farmstead as empty, lifeless husks.
summary: A blasted railway channel on the farmstead's slope, its tools, tents and unlaid sleepers left where the crew dropped them.
